[.verse-line]
[.i83]##{nbsp}##Mirth pleaseth some, to others ’tis offence,
[.i81]##{nbsp}##Some commend plain conceit, some profound sense;
[.i79]##{nbsp}##Some wish a witty Jest, some dislike that,
[.i86]##{nbsp}##And most would have themselves they know not what.
[.i182]##{nbsp}##Then he that would please all, and himself too,
[.i182]##{nbsp}##Takes more in hand than he is like to do.
